questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that bicycles may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This round sign means a railroad crossing is ahead. It is posted several hundred feet before the tracks. Slow down, look, listen, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road may be slippery when wet. Drive carefully on slippery roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is attached to vehicles that travel at slow speeds.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a yield sign is coming. Begin to slow down when you see this warning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A five-sided yellow or yellow-green sign warns drivers of a school zone or school crossing ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction. The right lane ends soon and traffic should merge left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns that the number of lanes will decrease and traffic must merge to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The railroad crossing is controlled. Continue at your regular speed.
Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
Stop at the railroad tracks and wait for a signal before crossing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, and prepare to stop at the crossing if necessary.
questions.explanation: At a railroad crossing, look and listen for trains. Slow down and be ready to stop. Do not cross until any trains have passed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells drivers to watch for pedestrians crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a flagger is ahead. Always follow their directions. Flaggers wear orange, yellow, or bright jackets. They use paddles and red flags to direct traffic through construction zones and let workers or vehicles cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red eight-sided sign always means stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs with black markings alert you to potential hazards. This sign warns that bicycles may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a one-way road. If you see this sign, traffic is coming toward you. Do not enter. Turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You should stop for other traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
Traffic is entering from another road and you should keep right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is entering from another road and you should allow additional space for drivers to merge safely into the flow of traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will merge into your lane ahead. Check your mirrors and side, then move to another lane if possible to give merging drivers space.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle sign means yield. Slow down and stop if necessary. If you stop, do so at the marked line.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop and check for traffic coming from both directions before proceeding.
Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
Maintain a steady speed and check for traffic coming from all directions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give the right-of-way to traffic on the road you wish to enter or cross.
questions.explanation: A three-sided yield sign means slow down and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass first. You do not have the right-of-way.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow signs with black lettering warn drivers about road conditions ahead. This sign warns that the right lane will end.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A downward-facing triangle is always a yield sign. Be prepared to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs indicate construction zones. Drive with caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You can travel in either direction in this lane.
You are approaching a divided highway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic flows in both directions on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that your road ends at an intersection ahead. Slow down and be ready to yield or stop before turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulatory sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This white regulatory sign with red and black markings tells you that U-turns are prohibited in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves left then right.
The road ahead curves right then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right then left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you the road will curve right first, then curve left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
Drivers may proceed through the intersection with caution.
Drivers must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Drivers must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: A solid red arrow means the same as a red traffic light. You must stop completely and wait for a signal that allows you to turn in your desired direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that wet pavement ahead can be slippery and dangerous. Slow down because it takes longer to stop on wet roads.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Slow-moving vehicles like farm tractors, maintenance vehicles, and animal-drawn carts display an orange and red triangle on the back.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No left turn can be made here.
A left turn can be made only after stopping.
All traffic must turn right at the next intersection.

questions.correctAnswerText: No left turn can be made here.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a diagonal line over a symbol means that action is prohibited. This sign prohibits left turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells you a divided highway is starting ahead. Stay in the right lane.
